findings.section: D3 — README.md, the model in use
findings.summary: The stated qualification rule is not the rule in docs/guide/evals.md.
findings.evidence: The brief says at docs/briefs/B20261126-1418-b45-docs-mixed-os-and-any-agent.loop-brief.md:147-148 that "at 3 runs, every eval case ... passes as the default Claude model does". docs/guide/evals.md:149-151 instead says that, on the same tool and runs, every case scores a mean no lower than the phase's default Claude model; it does not require the default Claude model to pass.
findings.fix: Restate the literal criterion from docs/guide/evals.md: at 3 runs, every case's mean score must be no lower than that phase's default Claude model on the same tool and the same runs. Keep the conclusion that mai-code-2 is not yet qualified.

decisions: Name both agents where both apply and retain text that is genuinely Claude-specific; agree.
Give mixed macOS/Windows teams a short README section that links the full configuration guide; agree.
Document mai-code-2's observed runs and evidence without calling the model qualified; agree.
Include this repository's operator and architect skill updates because its gates are pwsh; agree.
Do not pin line numbers because B40-B44 moved the documents; agree.
Keep Spanish templates and docs/domain out of scope except for contradictions; agree.
